name: Protection from Poison
summary: Ends the Poisoned condition on a creature and grants it Advantage and Resistance against poison.

stats.effect: You touch a creature and end the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition on it. For the duration, the target has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws to avoid or end the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition, and it has {ref:glossary/resistance} to Poison damage.
